causebase_summary: Geelong & District Day Nursery Incorporated (display name: Geelong & District Day Nursery Incorporated; website: https://geelongchildrenscentre.com.au/) is registered in Victoria. Evidence available for this subject comprises an ACNC register entry, the organisation’s website homepage, and an ACNC Annual Information Statement (AIS) for 01/07/2022–30/06/2023. The AIS reports revenue of AUD 3,936,353 and total expenses of AUD 3,592,605 for that reporting period. The organisation’s legal name and website name refer to a day nursery/children’s centre; the website snapshot in the evidence pack was not readable for extraction of further program or service details. No independent documentation of specific programs, participant numbers, service locations within Victoria, staffing or governance detail was provided in the selected excerpts.
